text:
A body is lifted against gravity.
Which equation shows the work done on the body?
A
work done = change in distance moved by the body
B
work done = change in energy of the body
C
work done = change in force on the body
D
work done = change in power of the body

options.label: A
options.text: work done = change in distance moved by the body

options.label: B
options.text: work done = change in energy of the body

options.label: C
options.text: work done = change in force on the body

options.label: D
options.text: work done = change in power of the body
